home.painTitle: The hard parts of planning Uzbekistan, solved
home.painText: We asked what makes tourists give up or overpay. Each answer below is a working feature of this website, not a promise.

pains.a: The AI trip planner builds a day-by-day route from our real tours, with realistic train and road times between cities.
Every tour shows an indicative price for your group size and date, in dollars, so‘m or euros, before you contact anyone.
The site and the assistant work in English, Uzbek and Russian. Ask in your language and the answer comes back in it.

pains.q: “I don’t want to prepay a stranger”
pains.a: Booking is a free request. Nothing is paid online and nothing is binding until our team confirms availability and the final price.
The travel guide and the assistant answer practical questions at any hour, and say clearly what you should double-check officially.
The assistant only quotes our own catalogue and links every tour it mentions. If it is unavailable, the site still searches our database and shows contacts.

about.title: A local agency from Jizzakh
about.lead: Silk Road Tours is a tour agency based in Jizzakh, the gateway between Samarkand, the Nuratau mountains and Zaamin National Park.
about.p1: We organise trips for two kinds of travellers: guests from abroad discovering the Silk Road for the first time, and families and companies from Uzbekistan looking for a weekend in the mountains or a holiday close to home.
about.p2: We design routes we know first-hand, work with local guides, drivers, guesthouses and yurt camps, and show real prices before you book.
about.value1Text: The price you see is calculated from our real rates for your group size and date.
about.value2Text: Every request reaches our team on Telegram the moment you send it.
about.value3Text: We work with family guesthouses, craftspeople and guides from the regions we visit.

contact.intro: Write to us in English, Uzbek or Russian. We reply on the channel you prefer.
contact.hours: We reply every day, 9:00–21:00 Tashkent time (UTC+5).
